skill.name: supabase-rls-review
skill.description: Review Supabase SQL migrations for row level security gaps and missing or blanket Data API grants (tables without RLS, using (true) write policies, anon write policies, security definer functions without search_path, public tables with no explicit GRANT (Supabase's changelog schedules a grants change for 30 Oct 2026), blanket grants to anon/authenticated). Use when the user asks to review RLS, Supabase policies, grants, a 42501 error, or database security before launch.
skill.summary: Review Supabase migrations for missing RLS, unsafe write policies, function search paths, and overly broad or missing grants.
skill.author: edtrackai

content.user_title: Review Supabase RLS and Database Grants
content.value_statement: Supabase migrations can leave tables exposed or deny intended Data API access. This skill reviews migration history for RLS, policy, function, and grant issues.
actual_capabilities: Read migration files in filename order and account for later fixes to earlier definitions.
Flag public tables without RLS and unrestricted write policies.
Identify write policies that allow anonymous access without authentication checks.
Flag security definer functions without explicit search-path settings.
Review missing per-table grants, blanket grants, and default privileges with migration-order context.
Produce severity summaries and findings with check identifiers, file locations, suggested fixes, and verification gaps.
limitations: Dashboard policies and tables created outside the supplied migrations cannot be verified from these files.
Checks are heuristics, not proof of vulnerabilities or a guarantee of database security.
The skill does not execute SQL or test live database access.
The cited grant-change schedule may change; verify current Supabase guidance before relying on its timing.

use_cases.title: Review Database Access Before Launch
use_cases.description: Check migration history for missing RLS, unrestricted writes, and broad grants before releasing a Supabase application.

use_cases.title: Investigate Data API Permission Errors
use_cases.description: Review per-table grants and earlier default privileges when new tables produce a 42501 permission error.

use_cases.title: Triage Migration Security Findings
use_cases.description: Collect file-level evidence, check identifiers, suggested fixes, and verification gaps for database access reviews.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Review Migration Security
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Supabase migrations for RLS and grant issues. Keep files unchanged and report findings with severity, check identifiers, locations, and suggested fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Investigate Missing Grants
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate a 42501 error for [table] using the migration history. Check per-table grants, earlier blanket grants, and default privileges. Report uncertainties.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Review Tenant Write Access
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [migration scope] for anonymous writes, unrestricted write policies, and ownership checks. Account for later migrations and list access assumptions requiring verification.

prompt_templates.title: Expert: Audit Migration History
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit all Supabase migrations in filename order against R1 through R6. Separate missing grants from blanket-grant findings and document evidence and verification gaps.

output_examples.input: Illustrative review of a public table without RLS and an unrestricted authenticated write policy.
output: Two critical findings: R1 identifies missing RLS, and R2 identifies an unrestricted write policy.
Suggested fixes: enable RLS and scope write access to the authenticated owner.
Verification gap: policies created in the dashboard were not available for review.

output_examples.input: Illustrative review of a new table covered by an earlier blanket grant.
output: R5 is not reported because an earlier blanket grant covers the table.
R6 flags the blanket grant and recommends explicit per-table privileges.
The review does not confirm live database permissions or successful Data API access.

best_practices: Provide the full migration history so later fixes and earlier grants can be evaluated in order.
State intended ownership rules and required database roles before assessing policy findings.
Verify dashboard configuration and live role behavior separately before applying suggested changes.
anti_patterns: Treating a clean heuristic report as proof that the database is secure.
Resolving missing-grant findings by granting access to every table.
Applying ownership-policy suggestions without checking the actual schema and intended access model.

faq.question: Does this skill modify migrations?
faq.answer: The default workflow is read-only. File edits require a separate user request for fixes.

faq.question: Which database issues does it check?
faq.answer: It checks missing RLS, unrestricted writes, anonymous write policies, security definer search paths, missing per-table grants, and blanket privileges.

faq.question: Can it inspect policies created in the Supabase dashboard?
faq.answer: Not from migration files alone. The report identifies dashboard policies and externally created tables as verification gaps.

faq.question: Does it account for later migrations?
faq.answer: Yes. It reads files in filename order so later changes can resolve earlier issues and earlier privileges can cover later tables.

faq.question: Can it help investigate a 42501 error?
faq.answer: It can identify missing grants in migration history. It does not test the Data API or verify live database permissions.

faq.question: Does a clean review guarantee security?
faq.answer: No. The checks are heuristics, and runtime permissions, dashboard configuration, and application behavior require separate verification.
